data_description.humidity_sensors: Stored for later use; not evaluated yet.
data_description.profile: Auto picks the first profile that matches all thermostats of the room.
data_description.window_detection: Switch the open-window detection of the thermostats on or off, or leave it as it is.
data_description.hysteresis: Temperature hysteresis of the thermostats in kelvin, or leave it as it is.

trv_unreachable.title: Thermostat {trv} in {room} is not responding

trv_firmware.title: Thermostat {trv} lacks a firmware feature
trv_firmware.description:
Easy TRV cannot use "{capability}" on {trv}. Required firmware: {required}. Installed firmware: {installed}.

Easy TRV skips this setting for this thermostat and keeps controlling it otherwise. Update the thermostat's firmware (for example through the ZHA over-the-air update) to enable it.

zha_api_incompatible.title: Easy TRV cannot use the Zigbee integration
zha_api_incompatible.description:
Easy TRV could not talk to the installed ZHA integration: {error}

If ZHA has just been (re)loaded, Easy TRV retries on its own and this issue disappears once it works. After a Home Assistant update that keeps failing, check for a newer Easy TRV version.

profile_invalid.title: Thermostat profile {file} is invalid
profile_invalid.description:
The profile file {file} in the easy_trv/profiles folder of your configuration directory was skipped: {error}

Fix or remove the file and reload the Easy TRV integration. This issue disappears when the file loads cleanly.

init.title: Easy TRV settings
init.description: These settings apply to all rooms.

data_description.refresh_minutes: How often the current room temperature is written to the thermostats again, even if it has not changed. 5 to 90 minutes.
data_description.verify_delay_seconds: How long to wait after a write before the value is read back from the thermostat to verify it. 2 to 60 seconds.
data_description.max_attempts: How often a failed write is tried before the thermostat is reported as not responding. 1 to 10.
data_description.min_delta_kelvin: A new room temperature is only written when it differs from the last written value by at least this much. 0.1 to 1.0 K.
data_description.sensor_timeout_minutes: A temperature sensor that has not reported for this long is ignored. 0 switches the timeout off, otherwise 10 to 720 minutes.

error.timeout_range: Enter 0 (off) or a value between 10 and 720 minutes.
